answer: Every claim climbs the saffron of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the plume re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the vertex of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
